# `csv` standard library

The `csv` module implements an RFC 4180 CSV/TSV reader and writer (supporting quoted
fields, escaped `""` quotes, embedded newlines, and configurable delimiters) together
with a `#!` compile-time structural typed row encoder and decoder (`csv::encode`,
`csv::decode`).

```{.dva .run}
#use csv
#use io
#use str

#type Item (id: Int, name: String, price: Float = 0.0)
#type Items Item{}

rows = Items()
rows += Item(1, "Widget, Large", 19.5)
text = csv::encode(rows)
csv::decode(Items, text) | dec =>
   r0 = dec(0)!!
   io::out $ r0.name + " $" + str::from_float(r0.price)
```

## Types and Function catalog

| Symbol / Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `csv::Row` | `String{}` | Single CSV row of string cells |
| `csv::Table` | `Row{}` | Table of CSV rows |
| `csv::read_all(text)` | `String => < Table | Error >` | Parses RFC 4180 comma-separated CSV text into a `Table` |
| `csv::read_all_delim(text, delim)` | `String, Int => < Table | Error >` | Parses CSV text with custom delimiter byte `delim` (e.g. `'\t'`, `';'`) |
| `csv::write_all(rows)` | `Table => String` | Serializes `Table` into comma-separated RFC 4180 CSV text |
| `csv::write_all_delim(rows, delim)` | `Table, Int => String` | Serializes `Table` with custom delimiter byte `delim` |
| `csv::encode(val)` | `#! T: Type, T => String` | Encodes `Table`, `R{}` / `R[]` array of records (emitting header row for named records), or single record `R` into CSV |
| `csv::encode_delim(val, delim)` | `#! T: Type, T, Int => String` | Encodes `val` into CSV text with custom delimiter byte `delim` |
| `csv::decode(T, text)` | `#! T: Type, String => < T | Error >` | Decodes CSV text into `Table`, `R{}` array of records (matching columns by header name or tuple position, honoring `f.default` and `<P|>`), or single record `R` |
| `csv::decode_delim(T, text, delim)` | `#! T: Type, String, Int => < T | Error >` | Decodes delimited text with custom delimiter `delim` into `T` |
